descriptor: Small studio showing twelve generated artworks

voice.summary: A gallery guide speaking at a low volume: measured, observant and a touch literary. It points at the work and then lets you look.
dos: Use title, year and palette in captions
Describe what the eye does, not what to feel
Keep sentences short with generous silence
donts: Art-speak words like oeuvre or interrogates

taglines: Choose a frame, enter the room
boilerplate: Frame by Frame is a studio that presents twelve generated artworks in a dark gallery, each opening into a large, close-looking detail view.

microcopy.error: That frame would not open. Try the next one

logo.note: An aperture mark nods to frames, lenses and looking closely.
